CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_narrative_internal.editorial_authority_v1(p_user uuid, p_campaign uuid, p_receipt uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_closing boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE c mission_narrative_internal.editorial_campaigns_v1;r mission_narrative_internal.editorial_runs_v1;dr mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts;
BEGIN
 IF p_closing THEN
  IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL OR NOT public.combat_v2_is_service() OR p_user IS NULL OR p_receipt IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'E65_CLOSING_SERVICE_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT r FROM mission_narrative_internal.editorial_runs_v1 WHERE receipt_id=p_receipt AND actor_user=p_user AND campaign_id=p_campaign;
  IF r.policy_sha256<>public.combat_v2_sha256(r.policy_snapshot) OR r.source_sha256<>public.combat_v2_sha256(r.source)
   OR NOT mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(r.policy_snapshot,ARRAY['policy','source_refs']) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'E65_FROZEN_CLOSING_DRIFT';END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT c FROM mission_narrative_internal.editorial_campaigns_v1 WHERE id=r.campaign_id;
  c.policy:=r.policy_snapshot->'policy';c.source_refs:=r.policy_snapshot->'source_refs';c.policy_sha256:=r.policy_sha256;
 ELSE
 IF p_user IS NULL OR (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND auth.uid()<>p_user) OR (auth.uid() IS NULL AND NOT public.combat_v2_is_service())
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles WHERE id=p_user AND role IN('admin','master'))
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.presence WHERE user_id=p_user AND location_id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b')
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.locations WHERE id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b' AND is_test AND is_active)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'E65_STAFF_CONTEXT_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT c FROM mission_narrative_internal.editorial_campaigns_v1 WHERE id=p_campaign;
 IF NOT c.enabled OR c.policy_sha256<>public.combat_v2_sha256(jsonb_build_object('policy',c.policy,'source_refs',c.source_refs))
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness root WHERE singleton AND state='enabled' AND scope='staff'
   AND revision_sha256=observed_revision_sha256 AND canonical_preimage::jsonb#>>'{config,c1266_editorial65,campaign_id}'=c.id::text
   AND canonical_preimage::jsonb#>>'{config,c1266_editorial65,policy_sha256}'=c.policy_sha256)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.runtime_policy native WHERE singleton AND native.policy_version=(c.policy->>'native_policy_version')::bigint AND native.model=c.policy->>'model' AND native.reasoning_effort=c.policy->>'reasoning_effort' AND native.store IS FALSE AND native.input_usd_million=(c.policy->>'input_usd_million')::numeric AND native.output_usd_million=(c.policy->>'output_usd_million')::numeric)
  OR c.policy->>'schema_version'<>'staff-editorial-policy/1' OR c.policy->>'model'<>'gpt-6-luna' OR c.policy->>'reasoning_effort'<>'high' OR c.policy->'store'<>'false'::jsonb
  OR jsonb_strip_nulls(c.policy)<>c.policy OR NOT mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(c.policy,ARRAY['schema_version','model','reasoning_effort','store','max_input_tokens','max_output_tokens','max_request_bytes','input_usd_million','output_usd_million','upper_call_usd','provider_deadline','close_deadline','max_pairs','max_http','budget_usd','prompt_revisions','history_scope_ids','total_budget_usd','native_policy_version'])
  OR (c.policy->>'max_input_tokens')::integer<=0 OR (c.policy->>'max_output_tokens')::integer<=0 OR (c.policy->>'budget_usd')::numeric<=0
  OR (c.policy->>'upper_call_usd')::numeric NOT BETWEEN 0.00000001 AND 0.20
  OR (c.policy->>'input_usd_million')::numeric<>0.1 OR (c.policy->>'output_usd_million')::numeric<>0.5
  OR (c.policy->>'upper_call_usd')::numeric<((c.policy->>'max_input_tokens')::numeric*0.1+(c.policy->>'max_output_tokens')::numeric*0.5)/1000000
  OR jsonb_typeof(c.policy->'history_scope_ids')<>'array' OR jsonb_array_length(c.policy->'history_scope_ids')<>6 OR (c.policy->>'total_budget_usd')::numeric<>4
  OR (c.policy->>'max_pairs')::integer>12 OR (c.policy->>'max_http')::integer>24 OR (c.policy->>'budget_usd')::numeric>2
  OR (c.policy->>'max_input_tokens')::integer>120000 OR (c.policy->>'max_output_tokens')::integer>20000
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'E65_CAMPAIGN_DISABLED_OR_STALE' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 END IF;
 IF p_receipt IS NOT NULL THEN
  SELECT * INTO STRICT r FROM mission_narrative_internal.editorial_runs_v1 WHERE receipt_id=p_receipt AND campaign_id=c.id AND actor_user=p_user;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT dr FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts WHERE id=p_receipt;
  IF (r.count_call_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls q WHERE q.id=r.count_call_id AND q.producer='mission_editorial_preview' AND q.source_id=dr.id AND q.scope_id=r.campaign_id AND q.call_no=2))
   OR(r.generation_call_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls q WHERE q.id=r.generation_call_id AND q.producer='mission_editorial_preview' AND q.source_id=dr.id AND q.scope_id=r.campaign_id AND q.call_no=1)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'E65_QUOTA_SCOPE_DRIFT';END IF;
  IF r.source#>>'{source_payload_sha256}'<>public.combat_v2_sha256(r.source->'source_payload') OR r.source#>>'{source_contract_sha256}'<>public.combat_v2_sha256(r.source->'source_contract')
   OR r.source_sha256<>public.combat_v2_sha256(r.source) OR r.policy_sha256<>c.policy_sha256 OR dr.authority_receipt_id<>r.id
   OR dr.event_kind<>'mission_editorial_preview' OR dr.renderer_version<>'mission-generic-editorial/1' OR dr.request_key<>r.request_key
   OR dr.master_session_id::text<>r.source->>'master_session_id' OR dr.envelope_sha256<>public.combat_v2_sha256(dr.envelope)
   OR NOT mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(dr.envelope,ARRAY['schema_version','run_id','campaign_id','actor_user','case_no','variant','stage','source_sha256','policy_sha256','request_sha256'])
   OR dr.envelope->>'schema_version'<>'staff-editorial-dispatch/1' OR dr.envelope->>'campaign_id'<>c.id::text OR dr.envelope->>'actor_user'<>r.actor_user::text
   OR dr.envelope->>'case_no'<>r.case_no::text OR dr.envelope->>'variant'<>r.variant OR dr.envelope->>'stage'<>'narration' OR dr.envelope->>'request_sha256'<>r.request_sha256
   OR dr.request_fingerprint<>dr.envelope_sha256 OR dr.authority_sha256<>public.combat_v2_sha256(jsonb_build_object('envelope_sha256',dr.envelope_sha256,'source_sha256',r.source_sha256))
   OR dr.envelope->>'run_id'<>r.id::text OR dr.envelope->>'source_sha256'<>r.source_sha256 OR dr.envelope->>'policy_sha256'<>r.policy_sha256
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'E65_RECEIPT_SOURCE_DRIFT' USING ERRCODE='40001';END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN c.policy;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mission_staff_editorial_prepare_v1(p_user uuid, p_campaign uuid, p_case integer, p_variant text, p_request uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE c mission_narrative_internal.editorial_campaigns_v1;r mission_narrative_internal.editorial_runs_v1;w mission_generic_owner.work_items;wc mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1;
 ref jsonb;src jsonb;pol jsonb;rid uuid;active_variant text;replayed boolean:=false;paired boolean;parent_run mission_narrative_internal.editorial_runs_v1;guide jsonb;chain jsonb;
BEGIN
 pol:=mission_narrative_internal.editorial_authority_v1(p_user,p_campaign,NULL);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT c FROM mission_narrative_internal.editorial_campaigns_v1 WHERE id=p_campaign FOR UPDATE;
 paired:=pol->>'schema_version'='staff-editorial-policy/2';
 SELECT canonical_preimage::jsonb#>>'{config,c1266_editorial65,active_variant}' INTO active_variant FROM mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness WHERE singleton;
 IF clock_timestamp()>(pol->>'provider_deadline')::timestamptz OR p_request IS NULL OR p_case NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 3 OR (NOT paired AND (p_variant NOT IN('baseline','canary') OR p_variant IS DISTINCT FROM active_variant)) OR (paired AND (p_variant NOT IN('director','writer') OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness er WHERE er.singleton AND er.canonical_preimage::jsonb#>'{config,c1266_editorial66,active_variants}' @> to_jsonb(ARRAY[p_variant])))) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'E65_CASE_VARIANT_INVALID';END IF;
 SELECT value INTO STRICT ref FROM jsonb_array_elements(c.source_refs) WHERE (value->>'case_no')::integer=p_case;
 IF paired THEN ref:=ref->p_variant;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT w FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=(ref->>'source_work_id')::uuid;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT wc FROM mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1 WHERE work_id=w.id;
 IF w.kind<>(CASE WHEN paired AND p_variant='director' THEN 'director' ELSE 'narration' END) OR w.state<>'completed' OR w.finalized_at IS NULL
  OR (w.kind='narration' AND w.message_id IS NULL)
  OR (w.kind='director' AND w.payload->>'schema_version'<>'mission-native-peaceful-assessment/1')
  OR (w.kind='narration' AND w.payload->>'schema_version' NOT IN('mission-generic-narration/2','mission-narrative-scene/1'))
  OR w.payload_sha256<>public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload) OR w.payload_sha256<>ref->>'payload_sha256'
  OR wc.contract_sha256<>public.combat_v2_sha256(wc.contract) OR wc.contract_sha256<>ref->>'contract_sha256'
  OR wc.payload_sha256<>w.payload_sha256 OR wc.master_session_id<>w.master_session_id
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_sessions m JOIN public.locations l ON l.id=m.location_id
   WHERE m.id=w.master_session_id AND m.owner_kind='ai_service' AND l.id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b' AND l.is_test AND l.is_active)
  OR (w.kind='narration' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.messages WHERE id=w.message_id AND kind='fato'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'E65_HISTORICAL_SOURCE_DRIFT' USING ERRCODE='40001';END IF;
 src:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','staff-editorial-source/1','source_work_id',w.id,'master_session_id',w.master_session_id,
  'source_payload',w.payload,'source_payload_sha256',w.payload_sha256,'source_contract',wc.contract,'source_contract_sha256',wc.contract_sha256,
  'source_header',jsonb_build_object('event_id',w.event_id,'request_key',w.request_key,'revision',w.revision,'encounter_id',w.encounter_id,'authority_receipt_id',w.authority_receipt_id),'source_scope',mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(w.id),
  'definition_sha256',w.definition_sha256,'source_kind',w.kind,'source_step_key',w.step_key,'source_run_control_version',w.run_control_version);
 IF paired AND p_variant='writer' THEN
  SELECT * INTO STRICT parent_run FROM mission_narrative_internal.editorial_runs_v1 WHERE campaign_id=c.id AND case_no=p_case AND variant='director' AND actor_user=p_user FOR SHARE;
  IF p_request IS DISTINCT FROM parent_run.id OR parent_run.state<>'completed' OR parent_run.finalized_at IS NULL
   OR parent_run.raw_sha256 IS NULL OR parent_run.retained_at IS NULL OR parent_run.raw_sha256<>encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(parent_run.raw_text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
   OR parent_run.result_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(parent_run.result) OR parent_run.result->'ok' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
   OR parent_run.source_sha256<>public.combat_v2_sha256(parent_run.source) OR parent_run.policy_sha256<>c.policy_sha256
   OR w.payload#>>'{combat_peaceful,assessment_work_id}'<>parent_run.source->>'source_work_id'
   OR w.payload#>'{combat_peaceful,source}' IS DISTINCT FROM parent_run.source#>'{source_payload,source}'
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts dr JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts at ON at.receipt_id=dr.id
    JOIN staff_ai_quota_private.calls q ON q.id=parent_run.generation_call_id
    JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit au ON au.receipt_id=dr.id AND au.event_code='editorial_finalized'
    WHERE dr.id=parent_run.receipt_id AND dr.authority_receipt_id=parent_run.id AND dr.status='success' AND dr.dispatch_count=1 AND dr.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
     AND at.status='success' AND at.cost_basis='exact' AND at.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND at.actual_cost_usd=q.charged_usd
     AND q.source_id=dr.id AND q.scope_id=c.id AND q.producer='mission_editorial_preview' AND q.state IN('settled','over_cap') AND q.charged_usd=dr.charged_cost_usd
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls cq JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit ca ON ca.receipt_id=dr.id AND ca.event_code='editorial_count_result'
      WHERE cq.id=parent_run.count_call_id AND cq.source_id=dr.id AND cq.scope_id=c.id AND cq.producer='mission_editorial_preview' AND cq.call_no=2 AND cq.state='unknown_billable' AND cq.sent_at IS NOT NULL AND cq.reserved_usd>0
       AND ca.details->>'run_id'=parent_run.id::text AND ca.details->>'request_sha256'=parent_run.request_sha256 AND ca.details->>'outcome'='success' AND ca.details->>'http_status'='200' AND (ca.details->>'input_tokens')::integer=parent_run.count_input_tokens)
     AND au.details->>'run_id'=parent_run.id::text AND au.details->>'outcome'='success'
     AND au.details->>'request_sha256'=parent_run.request_sha256 AND au.details->>'raw_sha256'=parent_run.raw_sha256 AND au.details->>'result_sha256'=parent_run.result_sha256)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'E66_PARENT_NOT_AUTHORITATIVE';END IF;
  guide:=mission_narrative_internal.native_peaceful_decision_v1(parent_run.source#>'{source_payload,source}',parent_run.source#>>'{source_payload,source_sha256}',parent_run.result->'decision');
  chain:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','staff-editorial-native-peaceful-chain/1','campaign_id',c.id,'case_no',p_case,
   'parent_editorial_run_id',parent_run.id,'parent_dispatch_receipt_id',parent_run.receipt_id,'parent_request_sha256',parent_run.request_sha256,
   'parent_raw_sha256',parent_run.raw_sha256,'parent_result_sha256',parent_run.result_sha256,'original_assessment_work_id',parent_run.source_work_id,
   'original_writer_work_id',w.id,'source',parent_run.source#>'{source_payload,source}','source_sha256',parent_run.source#>>'{source_payload,source_sha256}',
   'assessment',guide->'assessment','close_eligible',guide->'close_eligible','writer_next_step',guide->>'writer_next_step');
  src:=src||jsonb_build_object('schema_version','staff-editorial-paired-writer-source/1','chain_receipt',chain);
 END IF;
 IF p_variant='canary' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.editorial_runs_v1 old
  WHERE old.campaign_id=c.id AND old.case_no=p_case AND old.variant='baseline' AND old.actor_user=p_user
   AND old.source_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(src) AND old.state IN('completed','failed') AND old.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
   AND old.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(old.result)
   AND ((old.state='failed' AND old.receipt_id IS NULL AND old.count_call_id IS NULL AND old.generation_call_id IS NULL
     AND old.result->>'schema_version'='staff-editorial-preprovider-failure/1' AND old.result->>'provider_calls'='0'
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.editorial_audit_v1 a WHERE a.run_id=old.id AND a.event_code='preprovider_rejected' AND a.details->>'result_sha256'=old.result_sha256))
    OR (old.state='failed' AND old.result->>'outcome_uncertain'='false' AND old.result->>'generation_http_calls'='0'
     AND old.result->>'count_http_calls'='1' AND old.result->>'request_sha256'=old.request_sha256
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts d
      JOIN staff_ai_quota_private.calls q ON q.id=old.count_call_id AND q.source_id=d.id AND q.scope_id=old.campaign_id AND q.producer='mission_editorial_preview' AND q.call_no=2
      JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a ON a.receipt_id=d.id AND a.event_code IN('editorial_count_result','editorial_reconciled')
      WHERE d.id=old.receipt_id AND d.authority_receipt_id=old.id AND d.status='failed' AND d.dispatch_count=0 AND d.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
       AND q.state='unknown_billable' AND q.sent_at IS NOT NULL AND q.charged_usd IS NULL AND q.reserved_usd>0
       AND a.details->>'run_id'=old.id::text AND a.details->>'request_sha256'=old.request_sha256 AND a.details->>'result_sha256'=old.result_sha256
       AND ((old.generation_call_id IS NULL AND old.authorization_id IS NULL
         AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts WHERE receipt_id=d.id)
         AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_authorizations WHERE receipt_id=d.id)
         AND ((old.result->>'schema_version'='staff-editorial-count-failure/1' AND ((old.result->>'count_outcome'='failed' AND (old.result->>'http_status')::integer BETWEEN 100 AND 599 AND old.result->>'http_status'<>'200') OR (old.result->>'count_outcome'='success' AND old.result->>'http_status'='200' AND old.result->>'reason_code'='COUNT_INPUT_LIMIT' AND (old.result->>'input_tokens')::integer=old.count_input_tokens AND old.count_input_tokens>(old.policy_snapshot#>>'{policy,max_input_tokens}')::integer)))
          OR(old.result->>'schema_version'='staff-editorial-reconciliation/1' AND old.result->>'reason_code'='COUNTED_NOT_DISPATCHED')))
        OR(old.result->>'schema_version'='staff-editorial-reconciliation/1' AND old.result->>'reason_code'='GENERATION_AUTHORIZATION_EXPIRED_NO_HTTP'
         AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls g JOIN mission_narrative_internal.provider_authorizations z ON z.id=old.authorization_id AND z.receipt_id=d.id
          JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts at ON at.id=z.attempt_id AND at.receipt_id=d.id
          WHERE g.id=old.generation_call_id AND g.state='no_http' AND g.sent_at IS NULL AND z.consumed_at IS NULL AND z.expires_at<=old.finalized_at AND at.status='expired' AND at.actual_cost_usd=0)))))
    OR (old.raw_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND old.retained_at IS NOT NULL AND old.raw_sha256=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(old.raw_text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts d JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts a ON a.receipt_id=d.id
      JOIN staff_ai_quota_private.calls q ON q.id=old.generation_call_id
      JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit audit ON audit.receipt_id=d.id AND audit.event_code='editorial_finalized'
      WHERE d.id=old.receipt_id AND d.status='success' AND d.dispatch_count=1 AND d.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND a.status='success' AND a.cost_basis='exact'
       AND a.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND q.state IN('settled','over_cap') AND q.charged_usd=d.charged_cost_usd AND a.actual_cost_usd=q.charged_usd
       AND audit.details->>'run_id'=old.id::text AND audit.details->>'raw_sha256'=old.raw_sha256 AND audit.details->>'result_sha256'=old.result_sha256))))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'E65_BASELINE_SOURCE_NOT_DEFINITIVE';END IF;
 rid:=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(c.id,p_case::text||':'||p_variant);
 SELECT * INTO r FROM mission_narrative_internal.editorial_runs_v1 WHERE id=rid FOR UPDATE;
 IF FOUND THEN
  IF r.actor_user<>p_user OR r.source_sha256<>public.combat_v2_sha256(src) OR r.policy_sha256<>c.policy_sha256 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'E65_REQUEST_CONFLICT';END IF;replayed:=true;
 ELSE
  INSERT INTO mission_narrative_internal.editorial_runs_v1(id,campaign_id,actor_user,case_no,variant,request_key,source_work_id,source,policy_snapshot,source_sha256,policy_sha256)
   VALUES(rid,c.id,p_user,p_case,p_variant,p_request,w.id,src,jsonb_build_object('policy',c.policy,'source_refs',c.source_refs),public.combat_v2_sha256(src),c.policy_sha256) RETURNING * INTO r;
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version',CASE WHEN paired THEN 'staff-editorial-work/2' ELSE 'staff-editorial-work/1' END,'run_id',r.id,'campaign_id',r.campaign_id,'case_no',r.case_no,'variant',r.variant,
  'stage',CASE WHEN paired AND r.variant='director' THEN 'director' ELSE 'narration' END,'state',r.state,'request_key',r.request_key,'source',r.source,'source_sha256',r.source_sha256,
  'policy',jsonb_build_object('model',pol->'model','reasoning_effort',pol->'reasoning_effort','store',pol->'store','max_input_tokens',pol->'max_input_tokens','max_output_tokens',pol->'max_output_tokens','max_request_bytes',pol->'max_request_bytes','input_usd_million',pol->'input_usd_million','output_usd_million',pol->'output_usd_million','upper_call_usd',pol->'upper_call_usd','provider_deadline',pol->'provider_deadline','close_deadline',pol->'close_deadline'),'prompt_revision',pol#>>ARRAY['prompt_revisions',p_variant],'replayed',replayed);
END $function$

before.source:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mission_staff_editorial_prepare_v1(p_user uuid, p_campaign uuid, p_case integer, p_variant text, p_request uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE c mission_narrative_internal.editorial_campaigns_v1;r mission_narrative_internal.editorial_runs_v1;w mission_generic_owner.work_items;wc mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1;
 ref jsonb;src jsonb;pol jsonb;rid uuid;active_variant text;replayed boolean:=false;
BEGIN
 pol:=mission_narrative_internal.editorial_authority_v1(p_user,p_campaign,NULL);
 SELECT * INTO STRICT c FROM mission_narrative_internal.editorial_campaigns_v1 WHERE id=p_campaign FOR UPDATE;
 SELECT canonical_preimage::jsonb#>>'{config,c1266_editorial65,active_variant}' INTO active_variant FROM mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness WHERE singleton;
 IF clock_timestamp()>(pol->>'provider_deadline')::timestamptz OR p_request IS NULL OR p_case NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 3 OR p_variant NOT IN('baseline','canary') OR p_variant IS DISTINCT FROM active_variant THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'E65_CASE_VARIANT_INVALID';END IF;
 SELECT value INTO STRICT ref FROM jsonb_array_elements(c.source_refs) WHERE (value->>'case_no')::integer=p_case;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT w FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=(ref->>'source_work_id')::uuid;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT wc FROM mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1 WHERE work_id=w.id;
 IF w.kind<>'narration' OR w.state<>'completed' OR w.finalized_at IS NULL OR w.message_id IS NULL
  OR w.payload->>'schema_version' NOT IN('mission-generic-narration/2','mission-narrative-scene/1')
  OR w.payload_sha256<>public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload) OR w.payload_sha256<>ref->>'payload_sha256'
  OR wc.contract_sha256<>public.combat_v2_sha256(wc.contract) OR wc.contract_sha256<>ref->>'contract_sha256'
  OR wc.payload_sha256<>w.payload_sha256 OR wc.master_session_id<>w.master_session_id
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_sessions m JOIN public.locations l ON l.id=m.location_id
   WHERE m.id=w.master_session_id AND m.owner_kind='ai_service' AND l.id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b' AND l.is_test AND l.is_active)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.messages WHERE id=w.message_id AND kind='fato')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'E65_HISTORICAL_SOURCE_DRIFT' USING ERRCODE='40001';END IF;
 src:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','staff-editorial-source/1','source_work_id',w.id,'master_session_id',w.master_session_id,
  'source_payload',w.payload,'source_payload_sha256',w.payload_sha256,'source_contract',wc.contract,'source_contract_sha256',wc.contract_sha256,
  'source_header',jsonb_build_object('event_id',w.event_id,'request_key',w.request_key,'revision',w.revision,'encounter_id',w.encounter_id,'authority_receipt_id',w.authority_receipt_id),'source_scope',mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(w.id),
  'definition_sha256',w.definition_sha256,'source_kind',w.kind,'source_step_key',w.step_key,'source_run_control_version',w.run_control_version);
 IF p_variant='canary' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.editorial_runs_v1 old
  WHERE old.campaign_id=c.id AND old.case_no=p_case AND old.variant='baseline' AND old.actor_user=p_user
   AND old.source_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(src) AND old.state IN('completed','failed') AND old.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
   AND old.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(old.result)
   AND ((old.state='failed' AND old.receipt_id IS NULL AND old.count_call_id IS NULL AND old.generation_call_id IS NULL
     AND old.result->>'schema_version'='staff-editorial-preprovider-failure/1' AND old.result->>'provider_calls'='0'
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.editorial_audit_v1 a WHERE a.run_id=old.id AND a.event_code='preprovider_rejected' AND a.details->>'result_sha256'=old.result_sha256))
    OR (old.state='failed' AND old.result->>'outcome_uncertain'='false' AND old.result->>'generation_http_calls'='0'
     AND old.result->>'count_http_calls'='1' AND old.result->>'request_sha256'=old.request_sha256
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts d
      JOIN staff_ai_quota_private.calls q ON q.id=old.count_call_id AND q.source_id=d.id AND q.scope_id=old.campaign_id AND q.producer='mission_editorial_preview' AND q.call_no=2
      JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a ON a.receipt_id=d.id AND a.event_code IN('editorial_count_result','editorial_reconciled')
      WHERE d.id=old.receipt_id AND d.authority_receipt_id=old.id AND d.status='failed' AND d.dispatch_count=0 AND d.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
       AND q.state='unknown_billable' AND q.sent_at IS NOT NULL AND q.charged_usd IS NULL AND q.reserved_usd>0
       AND a.details->>'run_id'=old.id::text AND a.details->>'request_sha256'=old.request_sha256 AND a.details->>'result_sha256'=old.result_sha256
       AND ((old.generation_call_id IS NULL AND old.authorization_id IS NULL
         AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts WHERE receipt_id=d.id)
         AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_authorizations WHERE receipt_id=d.id)
         AND ((old.result->>'schema_version'='staff-editorial-count-failure/1' AND ((old.result->>'count_outcome'='failed' AND (old.result->>'http_status')::integer BETWEEN 100 AND 599 AND old.result->>'http_status'<>'200') OR (old.result->>'count_outcome'='success' AND old.result->>'http_status'='200' AND old.result->>'reason_code'='COUNT_INPUT_LIMIT' AND (old.result->>'input_tokens')::integer=old.count_input_tokens AND old.count_input_tokens>(old.policy_snapshot#>>'{policy,max_input_tokens}')::integer)))
          OR(old.result->>'schema_version'='staff-editorial-reconciliation/1' AND old.result->>'reason_code'='COUNTED_NOT_DISPATCHED')))
        OR(old.result->>'schema_version'='staff-editorial-reconciliation/1' AND old.result->>'reason_code'='GENERATION_AUTHORIZATION_EXPIRED_NO_HTTP'
         AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls g JOIN mission_narrative_internal.provider_authorizations z ON z.id=old.authorization_id AND z.receipt_id=d.id
          JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts at ON at.id=z.attempt_id AND at.receipt_id=d.id
          WHERE g.id=old.generation_call_id AND g.state='no_http' AND g.sent_at IS NULL AND z.consumed_at IS NULL AND z.expires_at<=old.finalized_at AND at.status='expired' AND at.actual_cost_usd=0)))))
    OR (old.raw_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND old.retained_at IS NOT NULL AND old.raw_sha256=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(old.raw_text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts d JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts a ON a.receipt_id=d.id
      JOIN staff_ai_quota_private.calls q ON q.id=old.generation_call_id
      JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit audit ON audit.receipt_id=d.id AND audit.event_code='editorial_finalized'
      WHERE d.id=old.receipt_id AND d.status='success' AND d.dispatch_count=1 AND d.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND a.status='success' AND a.cost_basis='exact'
       AND a.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND q.state IN('settled','over_cap') AND q.charged_usd=d.charged_cost_usd AND a.actual_cost_usd=q.charged_usd
       AND audit.details->>'run_id'=old.id::text AND audit.details->>'raw_sha256'=old.raw_sha256 AND audit.details->>'result_sha256'=old.result_sha256))))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'E65_BASELINE_SOURCE_NOT_DEFINITIVE';END IF;
 rid:=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(c.id,p_case::text||':'||p_variant);
 SELECT * INTO r FROM mission_narrative_internal.editorial_runs_v1 WHERE id=rid FOR UPDATE;
 IF FOUND THEN
  IF r.actor_user<>p_user OR r.source_sha256<>public.combat_v2_sha256(src) OR r.policy_sha256<>c.policy_sha256 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'E65_REQUEST_CONFLICT';END IF;replayed:=true;
 ELSE
  INSERT INTO mission_narrative_internal.editorial_runs_v1(id,campaign_id,actor_user,case_no,variant,request_key,source_work_id,source,policy_snapshot,source_sha256,policy_sha256)
   VALUES(rid,c.id,p_user,p_case,p_variant,p_request,w.id,src,jsonb_build_object('policy',c.policy,'source_refs',c.source_refs),public.combat_v2_sha256(src),c.policy_sha256) RETURNING * INTO r;
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','staff-editorial-work/1','run_id',r.id,'campaign_id',r.campaign_id,'case_no',r.case_no,'variant',r.variant,
  'stage','narration','state',r.state,'request_key',r.request_key,'source',r.source,'source_sha256',r.source_sha256,
  'policy',jsonb_build_object('model',pol->'model','reasoning_effort',pol->'reasoning_effort','store',pol->'store','max_input_tokens',pol->'max_input_tokens','max_output_tokens',pol->'max_output_tokens','max_request_bytes',pol->'max_request_bytes','input_usd_million',pol->'input_usd_million','output_usd_million',pol->'output_usd_million','upper_call_usd',pol->'upper_call_usd','provider_deadline',pol->'provider_deadline','close_deadline',pol->'close_deadline'),'prompt_revision',pol#>>ARRAY['prompt_revisions',p_variant],'replayed',replayed);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mission_staff_editorial_read_v1(p_user uuid, p_run uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE r mission_narrative_internal.editorial_runs_v1;cost numeric;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT r FROM mission_narrative_internal.editorial_runs_v1 WHERE id=p_run AND actor_user=p_user;
 IF p_user IS NULL OR (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND auth.uid()<>p_user) OR (auth.uid() IS NULL AND NOT public.combat_v2_is_service())
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles WHERE id=p_user AND role IN('admin','master'))
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.presence WHERE user_id=p_user AND location_id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b')
  OR r.source_sha256<>public.combat_v2_sha256(r.source) OR (r.result IS NOT NULL AND r.result_sha256<>public.combat_v2_sha256(r.result))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'E65_READ_DENIED_OR_DRIFT' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN state IN('settled','over_cap') THEN charged_usd WHEN state='no_http' THEN 0 ELSE reserved_usd END),0) INTO cost
  FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls WHERE id IN(r.count_call_id,r.generation_call_id);
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','staff-editorial-state/1','run_id',r.id,'campaign_id',r.campaign_id,'case_no',r.case_no,'variant',r.variant,
  'stage','narration','state',r.state,'source_sha256',r.source_sha256,'result',r.result,'result_sha256',r.result_sha256,'raw_sha256',r.raw_sha256,'receipt_id',r.receipt_id,'cost',cost,'reason_code',r.reason_code);
END $function$
